```cypher
MATCH (p:Plugin {component: 'block_quickscan'})<-[:MAINTAINS]-(m:Maintainer)
OPTIONAL MATCH (m)-[:MAINTAINS]->(otherPlugin:Plugin)
WHERE otherPlugin.component <> p.component
RETURN m.display_name AS Maintainer, p.name AS Plugin, COLLECT(DISTINCT otherPlugin.name) AS OtherPluginsMaintained
LIMIT 100
```
